#### Confront the mysterious person

**???:** So this is how you've neglected your duties, Sadunova... allowing two little rats to wander into my garden.

**Sadunova:** My lord...

**???:** To think this would be the first sight to greet me upon awakening... You allowed humans to trespass upon Kitezhgrad — a realm that should know only the rule of the fae.

**Sadunova:** The fault is mine, my lord...

**???:** Your punishment can wait. Go. You still have a ritual to prepare.

**Sadunova:** Yes... my lord.

**Paimon:** Hey! You're not getting away!

**???:** And what makes you think that's your decision to make, little one?

**Paimon:** She called you her master... Aha! So you're the one behind all of this! Give Thrud back right now, you... you crystal brute!

**The Shimmering One:** "Crystal brute"...? Hah. I rather like the sound of that. Still, I would prefer... "The Shimmering One."

**The Shimmering One:** Thrud... So that's how it is. You came all the way from Novokitezhgrad, going to all that trouble... just for "her."

**The Shimmering One:** And you even managed to follow us all the way here... Why, I'm almost "flattered."

**The Shimmering One:** I must admit, even those ugly, disagreeable little forms of yours are beginning to seem rather endearing.

**Paimon:** Hey! Who are you calling ugly!? You're the ugly one!

**Paimon:** Just look at you! You're all... hard and cold and crystall-y! What's so great about looking like that?

**The Shimmering One:** Hah... What could a witless little runt like you possibly know of beauty?

**The Shimmering One:** This crystalline form is but a single step removed from the divine. That you lack the eye to appreciate such grace is... regrettable.

**The Shimmering One:** Had that hooded woman not deceived me, I would have reached the heart of this mountain of bones long ago... Instead, I have been reduced to relying on something as crude and inefficient as Blightkristall.

**The Shimmering One:** Ah... Perhaps we might settle this another way. Submit to me. Kneel. Worship. Sing my praises... and perhaps I shall bless you with forms as beautiful as my own...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Hard pass...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Not if that's what we'd look like.

##### Shared continuation

**The Shimmering One:** How painfully shortsighted you humans are... Very well. I suppose our little negotiation is over.

**The Shimmering One:** But no matter... Whether you welcome it or not, I shall lavish every last drop of my affection upon you.

**Paimon:** Phew... S—See? You're not so unbeatable after all!

**The Shimmering One:** So neither of us can overcome the other... Fascinating. Never before has a human managed to meet me blow for blow.

**The Shimmering One:** This rush... this feeling stirring within me... Hehe. I could become quite addicted to it. And yet, even now...

**The Shimmering One:** Vast stores of Blightkristall are being converted and drawn into me... My power grows with every passing moment. And once I open the way to what lies hidden within this mountain...

**The Shimmering One:** ...You won't stand the slightest chance against me.

**The Shimmering One:** Ah... Soon. Very soon, the passage to the summit shall be restored...

**The Shimmering One:** Hehe... Until next time. When we meet again, I'll have such fun toying with you — like insects beneath my heel... until you have nothing left to give.

**The Shimmering One:** So be good and wait for me... I do hope you'll be looking forward to it.

**Paimon:** ...Ah! It got away again!

**Paimon:** It said a whole bunch of really worrying stuff just now... But Paimon did catch one important part...

**Paimon:** It's definitely been using those creepy black crystals for whatever big plan it's got.

**Paimon:** And apparently, it's trying to open some kind of passage... We don't know where it leads, but...

- **Traveler:** It can't be anything good.

#### Confront Sadunova

**Paimon:** Sadunova, why are you following that crystal monster's orders? You turned against the Grand Duke's court... You even betrayed Thrud!

**Sadunova:** Heh... Why should I explain myself to humans too ignorant to understand anything?

**Sadunova:** I have served one master, and one master alone, all along. Only my master can fulfill that person's great vow... the very vow that even Lord Alvis failed to fulfill...

**Paimon:** A great vow...?

**Sadunova:** A stunted floating Jack Frost like you could never understand... But you, human... surely you can hear it...

**Sadunova:** You can hear it... the dying cries of the one whose remains sprawl across this land. That accursed usurper erased even its name, but its will still lives on in our blood and bones.

**Sadunova:** Only the chosen, those of pure blood, can hear its call.

**Sadunova:** We carry out its will, for its will is ours as well.

**Sadunova:** My ancestors once followed the great Natalia, the Burner of Cities, and came within a hair's breadth of overthrowing this wretched nation. And now, I have taken up that same vow—

**Sadunova:** "To drive every human and outsider from this land and rebuild a nation for those of the primal bloodline!"

**Paimon:** Y—You're out of your mind!

**Sadunova:** On the contrary, I've never been more clear-headed. We fae carry the Cryo Dragon's flesh and blood within us. Who has a better right to rule this nation than we do? The filthy humans? Gods who can't even rule without answering to another?

**Sadunova:** Anyone foolish enough to stand against us deserves death!

**Paimon:** Traveler! Watch out!

#### Talk to Sadunova

**Sadunova:** No... Impossible! I was already...

**Sadunova:** How could I possibly lose to... a mere human and some stunted floating Jack Frost!?

**Paimon:** Hey! Knock it off with that nickname already! You... you big, mean red Vila!

**Paimon:** You don't look sorry in the slightest, so this is your last chance to come clean!

**Paimon:** Now, tell us where Princess Thrud is...

- **Traveler:** And who's this "master" of yours?

**Sadunova:** Absurd... This is utterly absurd!

**Sadunova:** This makes no sense... Why? Why should foolish, pathetic, insignificant humans ever wield such power!?

**Sadunova:** Why do you insist on standing in the way of the vengeance we swore to exact...?

**Sadunova:** Is fate itself nothing but some twisted joke...? After all we've done... after all this time...

**Paimon:** H—Hey! What do you think you're doing!? Just give up already!

**Sadunova:** Heh... heh... Give up? Not a chance!

**Sadunova:** I'd sooner die here than ever...

**Sadunova:** ...Bow to a human...

#### Examine the information left behind

**Paimon:** Isn't this what Sadunova was reading just now...?

**Paimon:** There are a whole bunch of manuals and records here...

**Paimon:** Let's see... Oh, here's a journal!

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "Alvis grows old and decrepit. Fear has begun to cloud his judgment, and he has even started to doubt himself... despite having at his disposal a power found nowhere else in this world..."

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "He is no longer the Grand Duke of the Domovoy he once was. He refuses to let anyone come into contact with it and has even made attempts to destroy [...], convinced that it is poisonous."

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "But I know... I know the power that thing possesses."

**Paimon:** Alvis... the Grand Duke of the Domovoy... Wait, Goggles, do you know anything about him?

**Eye of Graeae:** Alvis... He was one of His Majesty the Belyi Tsar's most trusted retainers during the Pale Star Court era. He made quite a name for himself in the wars that united the realm.

**Eye of Graeae:** He was also a member of Hvergelmir for a time.

**Paimon:** So that thing he got... could it have been a fragment of your power, Goggles?

**Eye of Graeae:** Whatever the case, that fragment is no longer here.

**Paimon:** Okay... Looks like there are a few more pages.

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "Her Majesty the Tsaritsa appears to value humans more highly than the fae. Perhaps that is because she herself is not [...]. Those who are not of our kind cannot be expected to think as we do."

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "How can those of us who bear such noble blood allow humans... these filthy, contemptible creatures... to rise above us once again?"

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "It was then that a woman calling herself Aksinya appeared. Whether her offer of assistance can be trusted remains to be seen. She claims revenge is all she desires... Is that truly so? Perhaps. In any case, this may be an opportunity worth exploiting."

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "Alvis... His death would be enough to satisfy Aksinya while also removing an obstacle from my path."

**Paimon:** So... whoever was behind all this research was working with Aksinya?

**Paimon:** This has gotta be that crystal guy... Did he and Aksinya kill Alvis together?

**Paimon:** But Goggles' fragment didn't stay in Novokitezhgrad... So what happened after that?

**Paimon:** Hmm... Looks like this next part was written much more recently...

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "That woman... I did not expect her to use the Shadow Realm to teleport me away at the last moment. The Pebble of [...] has been taken, and I no longer have access to the Palace of Glacial Reflections."

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "But it changes nothing. Everything is nearly ready. The trials have confirmed that energy concentration through Kristall conversion is possible. Before long, I will be able to return beneath the mountain where that great beast lies buried."

**Experiment Conductor's Notes:** "There, I will carry out the final transformation... and accomplish what no fae before me ever has..."

**Paimon:** And that's all it says.

**Paimon:** Hmm... So it teamed up with Aksinya to kill Alvis... but then Aksinya ended up with the thing Alvis had...

**Paimon:** So that's why it started using the Kresnik Kristall... It was turning itself into those creepy black crystals to somehow make itself stronger.

**Paimon:** Wait... So that crystal monster wrote all this! Hmm... But from what it says, it didn't always look like that...

**Paimon:** It must've only turned into that thing after the "transformation."

**Paimon:** But then... who was it originally...?

**Paimon:** Ah, we'll figure that out later! Right now, we've gotta stop it from transforming any more Kresnik Kristall!

**Paimon:** And we've still gotta find out what it knows about Princess Thrud!
